practices.practice: Create and reuse a single Mongoose/MongoClient per Node process (singleton) and size the pool for OLTP (e.g., maxPoolSize ≈ 50) rather than opening/closing a connection per HTTP request.
practices.prior_belief: Use a single shared Mongoose connection pool per Node process and configure maxPoolSize (e.g., 50) in the Mongo URI/options; never open/close a connection per HTTP request.
practices.source_name: Quickstart: Connect Mongoose to Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB MongoDB connection pool maxPoolSize Mongoose best practices DocumentDB connection pooling

practices.practice: Do not commit DocumentDB credentials into source; keep DOCUMENTDB_URI out of the repo, use a .env/.env.example for local dev and a secret store (Azure Key Vault / managed identity) in production.
practices.prior_belief: Do not commit credentials to source; keep DOCUMENTDB_URI out of the repo and use a secret store (Azure Key Vault) in production, with a .env.example placeholder for local dev.
practices.source_name: Quickstart: Connect Mongoose to Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: Don't commit DOCUMENTDB_URI .env azure documentdb

practices.practice: Open change streams with an aggregation pipeline filter (e.g., $match on fields or operationType) and use fullDocument:'updateLookup' only when you need the post-update document; persist resume tokens so streams can be resumed.
practices.prior_belief: Open change streams with a filtered aggregation pipeline (use $match on ns.coll or on operationType and specific fields) and set fullDocument:'updateLookup' only when you need the whole doc; persist resumeTokens so restarts resume where they left off.
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB change streams resume token persist resumeAfter fullDocument updateLookup

practices.practice: Embed bounded transition history in the trade document when size is bounded (accessed together) and maintain an append-only transition log collection for unbounded audit/query workloads.
practices.prior_belief: Model each trade as a single document with a transitions subdocument array (each entry: {from,to,timestamp,user,metadata}) and also write an append-only transition log collection for audit and efficient querying.
practices.how_found: documentdb-data-modeling

practices.practice: Use startSession() and withTransaction() to group related writes atomically, validate preconditions early, keep transactions short and small, and avoid non-idempotent external side effects inside the transaction callback.
practices.prior_belief: Use multi-document transactions via startSession/withTransaction to atomically advance state and write a transition log; keep transactions small (few docs, small byte size) and short-lived to avoid timeouts.
practices.source_name: Group multiple operations in transactions in Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB transactions startSession withTransaction best practices

practices.practice: Do not assume driver-managed retryable writes are enabled; Azure DocumentDB samples set retryWrites=false and recommend designing idempotent application-level retries rather than relying on retryWrites=true for non-idempotent operations.
practices.prior_belief: Set appropriate writeConcern and readConcern for transactional work (use writeConcern: { w: 'majority' } and readConcern: 'local' or 'majority' per consistency requirements) and ensure driver options include retryWrites=true for transient server errors.
practices.source_name: Quickstart: Connect Mongoose to Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB retryWrites=false why keep retryWrites false mongoose quickstart

practices.practice: Index every field used in filters and group keys for aggregation endpoints (create single-field or compound indexes on assetClass, counterparty, settlementDate for the settlement-rates aggregation).
practices.prior_belief: Index all fields used in filters and group keys for aggregation endpoints: create single or compound indexes on assetClass, counterpartyId, and settlementDate (e.g., { assetClass:1, counterpartyId:1, settlementDate:-1 }).
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB indexing index fields filters group keys aggregation best practices

practices.practice: For vector search use a DocumentDB vector index (cosmosSearch) and choose the algorithm and parameters (DiskANN, HNSW, or IVF, dimensions, lBuild/lSearch, maxDegree), and store normalized dense numeric arrays for cosine similarity.
practices.prior_belief: For vector search, create a vector index on the vector field with dimension and algorithm parameters (HNSW/IVF/M parameter and efConstruction) appropriate to your vectors, and ensure the field type is stored as a dense numeric array in documents.
practices.how_found: documentdb-vector-search

practices.practice: Avoid doing fullDocument lookups and heavy aggregations inside change-stream handlers; offload expensive processing to a worker queue and ensure durable checkpointing/acknowledgement so the stream cursor is not blocked.
practices.prior_belief: Limit full-document lookups and heavy aggregations in change stream handlers; offload expensive work to a worker queue and acknowledge/record the event before long-running processing to avoid change stream stalls.
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB change stream handlers avoid heavy processing offload worker queue checkpointing

practices.practice: Persist and version the change-stream resume token after processing each batch so restarts can resume without data loss.
practices.prior_belief: Persist and version the change stream resume token (e.g., in a small control collection or external durable store) after processing each batch so restarts can resume without data loss.
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB change streams resumeAfter store resume token example

practices.practice: Disable Mongoose autoIndex in production (autoIndex:false) and build/create indexes during deployment/ops rather than at application startup to avoid RU spikes and long startups.
practices.prior_belief: Set Mongoose option autoIndex: false in production and build indexes as part of deployment/ops, not at app startup, to avoid RU spikes and long startup delays.
practices.source_name: Use Mongoose with Azure DocumentDB: Build a Node.js inventory API
practices.how_found: Mongoose autoIndex false production azure documentdb tutorial

practices.practice: Choose a partition/shard key aligned with your hottest query patterns: for read-heavy choose the most frequent query filter, for write-heavy choose a high-cardinality, evenly-distributed field; avoid hot keys.
practices.prior_belief: Choose a partitioning/partition key aligned with your hottest query patterns (e.g., counterpartyId or assetClass) to avoid cross-partition queries for frequent transactions and to keep transactional work within a partition when required.
practices.how_found: documentdb-sharding

practices.practice: Keep transactions and state documents small, validate early, and fail fast to avoid transaction timeouts and resource contention.
practices.prior_belief: Keep transactions and state documents small to stay under engine limits (limit number of operations and document size inside a transaction) and fail fast if size thresholds are approached.
practices.source_name: Group multiple operations in transactions in Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB transactions keep transactions short avoid conflicts validate early

practices.practice: Use exponential backoff and idempotent retry semantics for transient network or rate-limit errors; cap retries and log incidents rather than blindly repeating non-idempotent writes.
practices.prior_belief: Use exponential backoff and idempotent retry semantics in application code for transient network or rate-limit errors; surface transient failures to a retry middleware that caps retries and logs the incident.
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB transient faults retry backoff idempotent retries recommendations

practices.practice: Avoid scatter/gather queries across many partitions for frequent/heavy aggregations; maintain pre-aggregated counters or materialized views updated atomically or by a low-latency change-stream worker instead.
practices.prior_belief: Avoid scatter/gather queries that touch many partitions for the aggregation endpoint; if the aggregation is frequent/heavy, maintain pre-aggregated counters (materialized views) updated in the same transaction or via a low-latency change stream worker.
practices.how_found: documentdb-sharding avoid scatter gather aggregation pre-aggregated counters

practices.practice: When building compound indexes put the most selective fields first and follow ESR (Equality → Sort → Range) to allow the index to serve your query shapes without a blocking SORT.
practices.prior_belief: Tune index keys for cardinality: put the most selective fields first in compound indexes (e.g., {counterpartyId:1, assetClass:1, settlementDate:-1}) and avoid indexing low-cardinality booleans alone.
practices.how_found: documentdb-indexing index-compound-esr

practices.practice: Instrument DB operations (latency, RU consumption, transaction commits/aborts) and export diagnostics to Azure Monitor / Log Analytics so you can alert on RU throttling, high latency, and repeated transaction aborts.
practices.prior_belief: Instrument operations with telemetry (request/response latency, RU consumption, transaction commits/aborts) and export to Azure Monitor/Log Analytics so you can alert on RU throttling, high latency, and repeated transaction aborts.
practices.how_found: documentdb-monitoring

practices.practice: Use TTL indexes on transition-log or ephemeral collections to automatically expire old audit entries instead of manual deletes.
practices.prior_belief: Use TTL indexes on transition log / ephemeral collections to automatically purge old audit entries (create TTL index on a timestamp field with the desired expiration seconds), rather than manual deletes.
practices.how_found: documentdb-indexing index-ttl-expiry.md

practices.practice: When running change streams against a managed cloud host, checkpoint frequently and avoid very long-running cursors without checkpoints to reduce the risk of resumability gaps and blocked processing.
practices.prior_belief: When running change streams against a managed/cloud Mongo-compatible host, limit the change stream visibility window by checkpointing frequently and avoid keeping a very long-running cursor without checkpoints to reduce chance of resumability gaps.
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB change streams checkpoint frequently resumability guidance

practices.practice: Check server compatibility (wire version / feature support) at startup and run the Azure DocumentDB compatibility assessment before migration; gate advanced features (e.g., vector index subtypes) behind runtime checks.
practices.prior_belief: Fail early when incompatible MongoDB server features are required (check server wire version / featureCompatibilityVersion at startup) and gate features like advanced vector index options or new transaction semantics behind runtime checks.
practices.source_name: Quickstart: Connect Mongoose to Azure DocumentDB
practices.how_found: Azure DocumentDB compatibility assessment check server wire version runtime checks
